purpose: Complete paired 160-frame development evaluation and independent audit; no checkpoint selection, training, model inference, or held-out access

mask_ap.official: unmodified pycocotools via verified v17 evaluator
mask_ap.resize: exact rational nearest pixel centers: original row y selects (2*y+1)//3, column x selects x//2; ties to upper pixel; avoids Pillow floating accumulator tie drift
mask_ap.ground_truth: all original positive visible label IDs; one class; no area filtering; iscrowd=0
mask_ap.confidence: float32 sigmoid of retained selected center, no calibration
mask_ap.primary: macro of ten scene AP; pooled AP separately

boundary.definition: positive pixels differing from any four-neighbor label; includes inter-instance and outer contours; Euclidean distance <=2
boundary.aggregation: pool precision/recall counts within scene; macro ten scenes
boundary.occlusion: true occlusion ratio unavailable; no fabricated occlusion metric

final_readonly: rebuild every cached decoder using independent NumPy implementation, maximum matching, dense-overlap COCO ranking and all primary precision/recall/score arrays; verify immutable files and both full frame/scene summaries
figure_rule: fixed frame 0000 of each scene plus six lowest RGBD frame-F1 rows, ties scene/frame ascending; descriptive development error visualization, no tuning
